entries.canonical: VYU-041infoPFS state not observed in this captureNo CREATE_CHILD_SA or Quick Mode exchange appeared in the capture, so PFS could be neither confirmed nor denied. Absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.NIST SP 800-77 Rev. 1 §5.3none110.73.0.210.73.0.3No child-SA rekey observedCapture across a rekey boundary (typically 8 hours) to confirm the PFS configuration.

VYU-031lowSHA-1 integrity is demoted to MUST-RFC 8221 moved AUTH_HMAC_SHA1_96 from MUST to MUST- in 2017. HMAC-SHA1 is not broken the way bare SHA-1 is, but it is on the way out and will not be mandated going forward.RFC 8221 §6 — AUTH_HMAC_SHA1_96 is MUST-BrokenCryptoAlgorithm110.73.0.210.73.0.3SHA1Schedule a move to AUTH_HMAC_SHA2_256_96. Low urgency; plan rather than panic.

VYU-033lowSHA-1 pseudorandom function is demoted to MUST-HMAC-SHA1 as a PRF is not broken the way bare SHA-1 is, but RFC 8247 moved it to MUST- and it will not be required of new implementations. It is a migration item, not an incident.RFC 8247 §3.2 — PRF_HMAC_SHA1 is MUST-BrokenCryptoAlgorithm110.73.0.210.73.0.3SHA1Move to PRF_HMAC_SHA2_256 alongside the cipher migration. In IKEv1 this is only reachable through interoperability extensions, which is a reason to migrate to IKEv2.

VYU-001mediumLegacy IKEv1 in useThe tunnel negotiates ISAKMP (IKEv1). IKEv2 resists denial of service, supports multiple key exchanges, and removes the Aggressive Mode identity leak entirely.RFC 7296 §1.1 — IKEv2 is the current Internet Standard for IKEnone110.73.0.210.73.0.3IKEv1Migrate the peer to IKEv2 and disable IKEv1 once both endpoints support it.

VYU-060mediumGateway identities disclosed on the wireThe following identities were readable without decryption: dcd96f48a85a8df63d32d740be2eaaa87f4d845277c335b280b458f0c70bb68a6d2c2eb649f8317abab9b23e2bd60bb16fbaf5db6fae1d7abd8ccbc598b11a2cf4ddac6a9ff6f2e5bedc01cdbe08da3e8f39c5c6e2638bb4b5e216aa3f70b8004d063ae849fc5929d4eae0ee260599a8fb4e18063a8c78460bbd2937. In a targeted environment this maps the trust graph of the organisation for free.RFC 4303 §3.1 — ESP hides its payload; the IKE identity is the leakExposureOfSensitiveInformation110.73.0.210.73.0.31 identitiesUse IKEv2, where identities travel inside the encrypted payload.

VYU-011high3DES in use — SWEET32 birthday exposureTriple-DES has a 64-bit block size. CBC mode leaks plaintext XOR after roughly 32 GB of ciphertext under one key, and a sustained high-throughput link reaches that in hours. This is CVE-2016-2183.RFC 8221 — ENCR_3DES is SHOULD NOT; NIST SP 800-131A retires TDEABrokenCryptoAlgorithm110.73.0.210.73.0.33DESMove to AES-256-GCM. If a peer cannot negotiate AEAD, use AES-CBC-256 with an explicit integrity transform.

VYU-002criticalIKEv1 Aggressive Mode sends the peer identity in the clearAggressive Mode exchanges ID and HASH unprotected, so a passive observer learns who peers with whom and can mount an offline dictionary attack against the pre-shared key. Observed identity: dcd96f48a85a8df63d32d740be2eaaa87f4d845277c335b280b458f0c70bb68a6d2c2eb649f8317abab9b23e2bd60bb16fbaf5db6fae1d7abd8ccbc598b11a2cf4ddac6a9ff6f2e5bedc01cdbe08da3e8f39c5c6e2638bb4b5e216aa3f70b8004d063ae849fc5929d4eae0ee260599a8fb4e18063a8c78460bbd2937.RFC 2407 §4.1; CVE-2018-5389 — IKEv1 PSK is offline-crackableKeyExchangeWithoutAuthentication110.73.0.210.73.0.3Aggressive ModeSwitch to Main Mode or IKEv2 and replace the pre-shared key with certificate authentication.

VYU-020criticalWeak Diffie-Hellman group (1024-bit MODP)The IKE SA is keyed over a 1024-bit finite-field group. Discrete logarithms in groups this size are within reach of a well-resourced adversary, and a passively recorded handshake can be decrypted later once the key is recovered. The Logjam measurement found 66% of scanned IPsec endpoints offering 1024-bit DH.RFC 8247 §3.3 — 1024-bit MODP is MUST NOT; NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5 sets 2048 as the floorInadequateEncryptionStrength110.73.0.210.73.0.3MODP-1024Negotiate ECP-256 or X25519 for equivalent strength at lower CPU cost, or 2048-bit MODP if a field is required.
